I have this email from a Swedish person but in English. I am lost. What does it mean? Could it be a mistranslation from Swedish?

"I will clean up this R05 and send you R06 as will be the proposed valid one.

 

I have a question how you see in this edition in D25, last time we had this in D25 was these as separate doc.

Continue with 10 so we have some close to true ?"

Hi My HR recently reclassified me as Web Developer I. I am writing an appeal letter to HR and management team to consider me as Graphic Designer II , or Web Developer II position. I will upload my appeal letter, standards for Graphic Designer II and Web developer II. can you check if my appeal makes sense ? What do you think that is the right position and level that I am more fit?

Thank you for sending the assessment data. I appreciate it. Yes, I would also like to review copies of the assessments themselves as they would help contextualize the data.
Please let me know if there’s anything specific you’d like me to focus on. I will review the data prior to our meeting to see how the data can best serve the program’s needs. I look forward to the meeting next week.

The total length of the content that I want to send you is too large to send in only one piece.
        
For sending you that content, I will follow this rule:
        
[START PART 1/10]
this is the content of the part 1 out of 10 in total
[END PART 1/10]
        
Then you just answer: "Received part 1/10"
        
And when I tell you "ALL PARTS SENT", then you can continue processing the data and answering my requests.

I need to calculate the volume of my pool in gallons.

It is a 12-foot diameter pool.

I made 12 measurements (in inches) around the pool:

1. 22 3/8
2. 22 1/8
3. 22 1/8
4. 22 3/8
5. 23 3/4
6. 24 3/4
7. 26 1/8
8. 26 1/2
9. 25 7/8
10. 25 7/8
11. 24 7/8
12. 23 3/8

Please provide me the average depth, the deepest point, and the shallowest point. 

Also provide me the amount of gallons of water in the pool.

Show all of your math work.
